Modest BTC/ETH gains and positive taker buying conflict with weak participation, negative latest settled ETF flows and contracting stablecoin supply. The evidence favors fragile stabilization rather than confirmed recovery or broad altcoin transmission. Longer-horizon downside forecasts are conditional, not established trends. These are descriptive, non-binding forecasts with no portfolio execution authority or framework changes.
